Liz (Docs): quick heads-up — ran the nightly kb link scan and found a weird frontmatter alias on /guides/runtime that redirects to /runtime/guide-old and is causing search mismatches. Can someone own a tiny fix? I can push a sed PR but need a reviewer.

Sam (Eng): gimme 10, I can take the review. if it's just an alias in frontmatter, `sed -i 's/guide-old/guide-new/'` should do it. what file path?

Liz (Docs): path is content/guides/runtime/index.md. frontmatter currently has `aliases: ["/runtime/guide-old","/runtime/runbook"]` — want to remove the `/runtime/guide-old` alias and set canonical. also noticed the diagram at `/assets/runtime/diagram.png` returns 403 in staging.

Anita (DevEx): if you're editing, please add `doc_owner: "Sam"` to frontmatter so the scanner knows who to ping next time. I'll block a small CR slot tomorrow morning (Mon 10:00 PDT) to review.

Sam (Eng): got it — will open a tiny PR, add commit 'fix(docs): remove stale alias, add doc_owner'. pinging @Maya for a quick visual check on the diagram after I rehost.

kb-scan-bot: nightly-kb-scan results: 1 broken alias detected, 1 image 403 observed. Report ID: kb-796543-2026-03-21.

Liz (Docs): perfect. Sam — if you can, rehost the diagram under `/static/rehosted/` and update the img path in the doc. if you can't rehost, leave a note in the PR and I will take the asset migration.

Sam (Eng): will rehost and link in PR. creating draft now. ETA ~30m.

Maya (Product): I can eyeball the diagram Monday AM. if the layout needs tweaks I can open a follow-up PR.

Liz (Docs): thanks all — tagging for follow-up: @Anita for CR slot, @Maya for visual. :thumbsup:
